Description: Added radio follow-up of ASKAP/DART J1832-0911 with updated polarization and phase-dependent RM. The study explores whether the source could be an ultra-compact asynchronous polar; this interpretation remains unconfirmed.

Added the radio-transient plane between the catalogue table and P–Ṗ diagram with cited pulse data including ASKAP J1745-5051 and LPT J1555-5631; sources without usable distance estimates are documented.
Added LPT J1555-5631 discovered in MeerKAT and ASKAP data.
Added optical and infrared follow-up of ASKAP J1448-68 identifying it as a cataclysmic variable.
Added FAST polarimetric follow-up of CHIME J0630+25 revealing extreme RM variability.
Added two VASTER-discovered long-period transients to the catalog.
Added total polarization fraction to the catalog table where available.
Added the reference of X-ray follow-up of ASKAP J1745-5051.
Added linear and circular polarization fraction columns to the catalog table.
Added the discovery of ASKAP J1745-5051 as an accreting white dwarf binary LPT.
Added the reference of optical follow-up of ILT J1101+5521.
Added the reference of FAST follow-up observations of GPM 1839-10.
Updated the sky distribution section and made the maps interactive.
Added the discovery of a 36-min LPT found by ASKAP
Thinking of building the LPT-Cat and website.
